notes: U1 masked wheel is the right wheel of the trailer's rear axle group (x~593-673); the tractor's drive wheels further right could also be called rear wheels, so the ref now says 'trailer wheel'. The trailer wheels already have bright silver alloy rims, so a silver hubcap would barely be visible; payload changed to a bright red hubcap. U2/U3 verified; no S!=T units.
